rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: At the opening of the Council's second term King Fahd commends 'the Chairman of the Shura Council, his deputy and the Council's staff'; the page then prints the speech of 'the Chairman of the Shura Council Sheikh محمد بن ابراهيم بن جبير'.
rows.locator: King's speech (opening of الدورة الثانية), closing paragraphs; heading كلمة معالي رئيس مجلس الشورى الشيخ محمد بن ابراهيم بن جبير

rows.text: In that speech the Chairman says the current council began with a historic opening under the King's patronage on 16 Rajab 1414 AH, held its first session four days later and formed eight committees, and he summarises its work up to 2/3/1418.
rows.locator: Chairman's speech, paragraph بدأت مسيرة المجلس الحالي بافتتاح تاريخي

bounded_scope: Chair observations for CLAUDE-C01-25 only (sa_shura_chair and sa_succession_chair).
